stories.headline: Swindon Supermarine reclaimed top spot thanks to a 93rd minute Jowan Partridge winner, which was…
stories.body: Swindon Supermarine reclaimed top spot thanks to a 93rd minute Jowan Partridge winner, which was his first goal for the club. The game finished 1-2 as Supermarine overcame Larkhall Athletic , with Brad Hooper opening the scoring for Supermarine after 39 minutes, before Ben Cleary equalised in the 62nd minute for the Larks.
stories.source_title: Dyno-Rod Wednesday Night Round-Up | All three away sides win as a 93rd minute winner sends Swindon Supermarine top
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: Supermarine return to the top, on goal difference over Dorchester Town, after their third successive…
stories.body: Supermarine return to the top, on goal difference over Dorchester Town, after their third successive win since defeat to Dorchester. While Larkhall Athletic remain 20th but should take encouragement from holding the league leaders to the 93rd minute, following a draw with fellow-strong starters this season Bishops Cleeve.

stories.headline: A Joshua Barry brace decided the fixture with Barnstaple Town picking up a 0-2 win…
stories.body: A Joshua Barry brace decided the fixture with Barnstaple Town picking up a 0-2 win, moving Barum up to 16th after their first win at the sixth attempt. It leaves Willand one place above them in 15th, who are now four without a win.

stories.headline: Swindon Supermarine have the chance to reclaim top spot tonight as they travel to 20th…
stories.body: Swindon Supermarine have the chance to reclaim top spot tonight as they travel to 20th place Larkhall Athletic . Supermarine bounced back from two successive defeats with two successive wins over Bideford and Willand Rovers, both 0-2 away from home.
stories.source_title: Wednesday Night Preview | Swindon Supermarine look to reclaim top spot as three fixtures round of our midweek action

stories.headline: However, Larkhall will have something to say about Supermarine's chances of going top, as they…
stories.body: However, Larkhall will have something to say about Supermarine's chances of going top, as they took a point off high-flyers Bishops Cleeve last time out. Supermarine this week announced the contract extension of manager Bobby Wilkinson until the end of the 2028/29 season.

stories.headline: Willand are looking for their first win in three after losing 0-2 to Swindon Supermarine…
stories.body: Willand are looking for their first win in three after losing 0-2 to Swindon Supermarine last time out, while Barnstaple haven't won in five since a 1-4 win at Melksham Town. You can keep up with the live scores tonight on the Live Events page of our website. You can also get your predictions in on our Predictions Game .
